name: heuristic_near_miss_buttons
description: When buttons are hard to hit or taps land next to them, make the buttons bigger.

steps.description: How much to change: 1 is a little, 3 is a lot. Use 1 when unsure.

name: heuristic_text_zoom
description: When text is hard to read or the user tries to zoom in on messages, make the text bigger.

steps.description: How much to change: 1 is a little, 3 is a lot. Use 1 when unsure.
